leads.title: Mauritania Criminal Code (1983), Article 308
leads.documents: Legal status of same-sex sexual activity: Sharia-based law; adult Muslim man faces death by public stoning (Rajm) for impudent/unnatural act with male; women who have sex with women face 3 months to 2 years prison and 5,000 to 60,000 Ouguiya fine
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Article 308 of the 1983 Criminal Code' with quoted penalty language; no URL visible in provided text

leads.documents: Documented enforcement incident: 10 men arrested and detained after video allegedly of gay wedding posted to social media (later revealed as birthday party); commissioner said men arrested for imitating women
